verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an Alerts feature, but the pack gives only its title. Its official MCP server answers connection-level sync-status questions such as "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?". Neither shows per-destination-table freshness or an alert tied to a missed expected cadence. Missing for 10: per-table freshness visibility, documented alerting on missed sync cadence or schedule, details of what Fivetran Alerts covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I can tell how fresh each destination table is and get warned when a pipeline misses its expected cadence

citations.quote: It allows you to ask read-only questions like "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?"
